doc.summary: Creates the <ref cls="net/neoforged/neoforge/client/extensions/common/IClientFluidTypeExtensions">client extensions</ref> and the <ref cls="net/minecraft/client/renderer/block/FluidModel">fluid model</ref> for this fluid.
doc.text:
Creates the client extensions and the fluid model for this fluid. The default implementation creates client extensions that have no special properties and a fluid model without
tint that uses a still texture located at [namespace]:block/[path] and a flowing texture located at [namespace]:block/[path]_flowing.

Gets the <ref cls="net/minecraft/world/level/material/Fluid">source fluid</ref> for this <ref cls="org/moddingx/libx/base/FluidBase">FluidBase</ref>. This is the same as <ref cls="org/moddingx/libx/base/FluidBase" method="getSourceFluid" type="()net.minecraft.world.level.material.Fluid">#getSourceFluid()</ref>. One should prefer this method over <ref cls="org/moddingx/libx/base/FluidBase" method="getSourceFluid" type="()net.minecraft.world.level.material.Fluid">#getSourceFluid()</ref> when needing a representative for the whole <ref cls="net/neoforged/neoforge/fluids/FluidType">fluid type</ref>, for example when creating <ref cls="net/neoforged/neoforge/fluids/FluidStack">fluid stacks</ref>.

Gets the <ref cls="net/minecraft/world/level/material/Fluid">source fluid</ref> for this <ref cls="org/moddingx/libx/base/FluidBase">FluidBase</ref>. This is the same as <ref cls="org/moddingx/libx/base/FluidBase" method="getFluid" type="()net.minecraft.world.level.material.Fluid">#getFluid()</ref>. One should prefer this method over <ref cls="org/moddingx/libx/base/FluidBase" method="getFluid" type="()net.minecraft.world.level.material.Fluid">#getFluid()</ref> when a distinction between source and flowing fluids is to be made.

Gets the liquid block for this FluidBase.

The liquid block is created during registration, as its id is not known before. Therefore, this method
must not be called during construction or static initialization of the FluidBase and will throw an IllegalStateException until the fluid has been registered. It is however safe to pass a method reference to this method around, as long as it is only invoked after registration.

Gets the bucket item for this FluidBase.

The bucket item is created during registration, as its id is not known before. Therefore, this method
must not be called during construction or static initialization of the FluidBase and will throw an IllegalStateException until the fluid has been registered. It is however safe to pass a method reference to this method around, as long as it is only invoked after registration.

doc.summary: This is the same as <ref cls="org/moddingx/libx/base/FluidBase" method="getBucketItem" type="()net.minecraft.world.item.BucketItem">#getBucketItem()</ref> and allows <ref cls="org/moddingx/libx/base/FluidBase">FluidBase</ref> to be used as an <ref cls="net/minecraft/world/level/ItemLike">ItemLike</ref>.
doc.text:
This is the same as #getBucketItem() and allows FluidBase to be used as an ItemLike.

Just like #getBucketItem(), this throws an IllegalStateException if the fluid has not been registered yet, so a FluidBase must not be used as an ItemLike before registration.
